question.text: The primary and secondary valencies of cobalt respectively in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced open="[" close="]"><mrow><mi>Co</mi><mo>(</mo><msub><mi>NH</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><msub><mo>)</mo><mn>5</mn></msub><mi>Cl</mi></mrow></mfenced><msub><mi>Cl</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> are:

solution.text:
Co(NH3)5ClCl2

The primary valency is the ionisable valency.  Oxidation number of Co is +3. So, primary valency is 3. Secondary valency refers the coordination number. It is an octahedral complex so, secondary valency is 6.
